description: Verify an Ethereum signature offline: recovers the signer address (secp256k1 ecrecover) from an EIP-191 personal_sign message (UTF-8 or hex) or a raw 32-byte digest (e.g. an EIP-712 hash), compares it with an expected address, flags malleable high-s signatures, accepts 65-byte r,s,v and 64-byte EIP-2098 compact signatures, and parses Sign-In with Ethereum (EIP-4361) messages (domain, nonce, chain, expiry). For smart-contract wallets (EIP-1271) recovery does not apply. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-verify-signature

address.description: Expected signer, to get match true/false

hash.description: Raw 32-byte digest that was signed (no prefix added), e.g. an EIP-712 digest

message.description: Signed message for personal_sign (EIP-191); give message or hash

messageEncoding.description: How to read message: UTF-8 text or 0x-hex bytes

signature.description: 0x signature: 65 bytes r,s,v or 64 bytes EIP-2098

name: evm_verify_signature
title: Evm Verify Signature
